purpose: One public, fresh Node --version exec attempt under the unchanged original QA profile while one bounded log stream already uses the exact newly reserved Node-carrier PID token. Obtain public sandbox-denial evidence without another guessed profile rule.
order: Admit five held full9/hash public inputs and the known Node alias; create-only two public HOME roots; copy/readback exact original6909 profile.
One Python direct child establishes a session, reports its own fixed ready PID and waits for one byte; original capture_child binds actual PID/PPID/PGID/UID/birth.
Freeze log predicate to that reserved PID's full node(PID) token and three closed origin names; launch log stream without the Node test profile and capture its original custody.
Read both pipes during a measured 0.25s queue interval; neither ready output nor live log process is a subscription acknowledgement. Require pregate interval below2s.

Write exactly one G byte once; close writer once. Child emits release marker and source calls execve sandbox-exec->Node --version at the same PID. Actual final executable image is not independently sampled.

Read all four output pipes under per-child/shared caps and WNOWAIT; retain both exited children unreaped while capturing. Only exact PID/time and explicit denial syntax can produce public denial projections.

Immediately on successful observe return (<START+17), protected pair.close attempts log cleanup then Node cleanup using original once-only WNOWAIT helper; every registered pipe closes once. Later projection uses cached bytes only; finally is guarded by original once flags.
Project already captured bytes and verify original held/name input/HOME fences; close all held files and restore handlers. Deadline/failure/UNKNOWN remains explicit.
predicateTemplate: (process == "node" OR process == "kernel" OR process == "sandboxd") AND message CONTAINS "node(<actual Popen PID>)"
predicatePIDSource: Only bounded actual Popen PID from the newly created direct child, with captured ownership; never a user-provided number or old PID.

primaryRoles: gated Node carrier, same PID through exec attempt
explicitOwnership.commandsUse: Exact Commands.__init__ and Commands.public; synchronous Commands.run is not called because it cannot overlap two children. New fixed coordinator calls exact original capture/exit/stop functions.
explicitOwnership.extraGateSemantics: The child closes its standard input after consuming G; it executes no JS and receives no private data. Ready/released markers plus source support an exec-attempt inference, not an independently observed kernel-image transition.

projection.required: Consistent closed process, all supplied message candidates equal strings, exact numeric current PID for node OR complete current node(PID) subject for kernel/sandboxd, parsed timezone-bearing timestamp in measured gate-to-EOF window, and explicit node(PID) deny syntax.
projection.publicResourceRule: Byte-exact known public inputs (including /), com.apple.* Mach names, bounded public sysctl names, safe system/library paths; original public_resource grammar retained. Unknown operations/resources produce null/false only.

mechanical.InputAuditChangesOnlyMaxFD5AndNewWholeBy: Inherited unchanged from SOURCE R1; no R2 input changes.
R2ChangesOnly: Latch first on-time complete exit+EOF per row; retain first completion monotonic/wall times, never clear completion while waiting for the other child.
After observe returns, immediately use existing protected pair.close before projection/fences, so original two9s cleanup reserve starts bySTART+17. Finally reuses existing once flags.

limits: A normal log process, warmup, banner or elapsed time is not a subscription readiness proof.
The token/origin filter can miss redacted PIDs, different reporters and formats. Dropped/unknown rows remain unknown; no empty-result absence inference.
A shared wall clock can regress: measured-order validation then fails. Every monotonic deadline stays independent.
Popen and file syscalls are synchronous; checks occur before/after, and the outer Native60 cap is unchanged. Kernel-internal/loader/temporary Popen FDs are not claimed individually inventoried.
The true direct-child ownership source still contains its original bounded ps observations; their possible refusal is not masked.
Source markers and execve control flow do not alone prove the kernel reached the final Node image. A public version string or known retained exit is a new observation only.

knownSourceBlockers: recomputed completed flag could expire Node while waiting for log
projection/fences before cleanup could consume cleanup reserve
